description: Burn black redaction boxes into a PDF: pick a page, enter a rectangle in points (page-size helper included), and download the redacted file.

faqs.a: Yes — the boxes are drawn into the page content itself, so they cannot be removed by selecting text or editing layers.
PDF coordinates start at the bottom-left corner of the page, measured in points (1/72 inch). The tool shows the current page's exact size.
Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Upload a PDF and pick a page number.
Check the page-size helper (width × height in points).
Enter the rectangle's x, y, width and height in points.
Add as many boxes as needed, then "Apply & Download".
title: PDF Redactor
